name: starflow
title_zh: 滚动时星群散开又聚成你logo的暗色启动页
tagline_zh: 受 Astra 启发的暗色启动页，星群随滚动倾斜、散入侧轨，再聚成光标、绳结或你自己的 logo 路径。
tagline_en: Astra-style dark hero: stars tilt, scatter into rails, and re-form into your logo as you scroll. A living galaxy.
desc_en: Build an Astra-style dark launch page or hero: a bundled three.js starfield (Starflow engine) that tilts, scatters into side rails and re-forms into a cursor, a knot, or the user's own logo path as the reader scrolls. Use for product launches, model announcements, "new generation" reveals, or any hero that needs a living galaxy instead of a static gradient. Ships the engine, a wired page skeleton,
why_zh: 星群不是贴图，是内置 three.js 引擎实时算的。散开与重组都绑定滚动进度。
why_en: Stars are live-computed by a bundled three.js engine, not a sprite. Scatter and re-form are bound to scroll progress; swap in.
limit_zh: 只产出暗色启动页/Hero 骨架，不含完整营销站组件。需自己接入滚动容器与 logo 路径。
limit_en: Dark launch/hero skeleton only, no full marketing-site blocks. You wire the scroll container and logo path; unsuitable for light themes or.
